footage.need: A screen recording of your own DSA practice: your notes, a solved problem or your streak page. Scroll slowly and keep personal info off screen.

Two short Claude Code screen recordings of the same small task: one where you type "do it", one where you type "explain why, then I'll write it". Just the prompt and the start of the answer, about 5 s each.
